# Hardcoded hooks append to the existing handlers (the mod's on_action form). REBELTAG: the empire, not a rebel state.
# root = location, scope:loser = previous owner, scope:winner = new owner (can be null). A place of a historical region
# (2-39) the empire takes from a foreign hand (not from its own subject) counts as gained for 20 years.
on_location_changed_owner = { on_actions = { oe_fs_gain_mark } }
oe_fs_gain_mark = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        has_variable = oe_theme_region
        var:oe_theme_region >= 2
        exists = scope:winner
        scope:winner = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
        exists = scope:loser
        scope:loser = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:BYZ } }
    }
    effect = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_gained years = 20 } }
}
